references.text: The same command to fear the Lord, serve him, and swear by his name
Repetition of the command to fear the Lord, serve him, and hold fast to him
Those who held fast to the Lord are still alive - the same theme of holding fast to God
Command to keep the commandments, love the Lord, and hold fast to him
Loving the Lord, listening to his voice, and holding fast to him gives life
Joshua repeats the command to love the Lord, walk in his ways, and hold fast to him
Command to hold fast to the Lord your God
Hezekiah held fast to the Lord and followed his commands - an example of fulfilling this command
Jesus quotes that one must worship the Lord your God and serve only him
Jesus quotes the command to worship and serve the Lord alone
Barnabas encouraged believers to hold fast to the Lord with all their heart
